column1: # Common food plants preset for the Evo Tree viewer.
# One crop per line: scientific name <TAB> common names (comma-separated; first one is the label) <TAB> tags.
# Several crops from one species are merged (e.g. Brassica oleracea = broccoli, cabbage, kale, ...).
# Tags drive the sub-lists: fruit, berry, herb (herbs & spices). Every line is in "all food".
# Names follow WFO (pea = Lathyrus oleraceus, lentil = Vicia lens, pearl millet = Cenchrus americanus).
# Mushrooms are left out (fungi aren't on the land-plant tree).
